statement: Dissolving a Delaware corporation requires a resolution adopted by a majority of the whole board deeming dissolution advisable followed by a vote of a majority of the outstanding stock entitled to vote, or alternatively the written consent of all stockholders entitled to vote, and then a certificate of dissolution filed under § 103 (8 Del. C. § 275(a)-(d)).
caveat: Franchise taxes must be paid before the Division of Corporations accepts the certificate. Short-form § 274 and other paths exist for special cases. This repo does not execute or sequence a dissolution.
